coordinate_convention.visual_glb: meters, Z-up, footprint-center origin, bottom Z=0
coordinate_convention.collision_stl: millimeters, Z-up, footprint-center origin, bottom Z=0
coordinate_convention.interaction_points: raw DOBOT controller pose, likely millimeters/degrees; never baked into proxy meshes

measurement_policy.scale_method: photo proportions + confirmed CR5A 900 mm working radius + point-grid pitch + common laboratory resource dimensions
measurement_policy.warning: Estimated dimensions are layout priors, not metrology. Preserve raw point poses independently.

collision_policy.closed_enclosures: solid proxy is acceptable for layout-only collision
collision_policy.open_racks_and_workstations: use multiple structural sub-bodies so shelves, bays and interaction cavities remain reachable
collision_policy.warning: A whole-device AABB may be retained only as an optional coarse-layout envelope, never as the precision interaction collision model.

confirmed_models.compatibility_boundary: The photos and official manual identify CR5A, while the available official ROS asset is named CR5. Use it for simulation only until CR5A DH/link geometry is verified. CR5AF belongs to the force-control CRAF series and must not be substituted.
confirmed_models.do_not_use_meshy_reason: An image-generated monolithic shell would destroy joint articulation and calibrated kinematics.
